visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a female creator in a light blue cropped sweater, white pants, and a thick grey fur headband standing outside a bright yellow Bónus supermarket in Iceland. She gestures dynamically with her arms toward the building's yellow facade and a pink sign saying 'Velkomin.' The lighting is natural daylight, showing a clear, overcast sky. (2) She enters the store and discovers a small, bright pink shopping cart with a flag featuring a cartoon pig logo. She picks up the flag, showing a surprised facial expression with wide eyes and an open mouth. The interior is brightly lit with supermarket fluorescent lights. (3) The creator walks through the aisles, pushing the pink cart which contains a bottle of orange juice and other items. She looks at the shelves lined with various canned goods and condiments, holding the handle with both hands. (4) She picks up a yellow package of bread, holding it close to the camera to show the Bónus pig logo. In the background, yellow shelving units are visible. (5) She reaches for a jar of Saltverk lava salt from a circular wire display rack. The jar is black with a white label. She shows the price tag on the shelf. (6) Moving to the refrigerated section, she points at packages of 'Smash Style' beef patties. The display shows various cuts of red meat behind glass or on open refrigerated shelves. (7) A second woman with black hair and a beige jacket appears, pointing to 'Grijonagrautur' (rice pudding) tubs on a shelf. The main creator holds a tub toward the camera to show the blue and white packaging. (8) The camera focuses on 'Isey Skyr' yogurt tubs. The creator's hand with gold rings and a gold watch points at the different flavors and price tags on the metal shelf. (9) She holds a large bottle of Floridana Goji juice, rotating it to show the orange liquid and the label. Her expression is informative as she speaks directly to the camera. (10) She stands in front of a glass-door refrigerator containing various pre-packaged wraps and sandwiches. She points at a 'Jumbo' brand wrap. (11) She opens a refrigerator door and pulls out a plastic bottle of Coca-Cola Zero. Rows of blue and red beverage bottles are visible behind the glass. (12) The second woman finds large clear tubs of blueberries. The main creator holds a tub up, showing the dark berries inside. An older woman shopper in a grey fleece is visible in the background. (13) Pushing the cart again, she stops by the snack aisle and points to large pink bags of Bónus onion-flavored snacks stacked on the shelves. (14) In a different section, possibly alcohol, a male staff member in a black shirt is seen stocking shelves. The creator points at bottles of 'Jökla' cream liqueur with an Icelandic flag on the label. (15) Finally, the creator is back outside with two female friends. All three are holding various grocery items and a long receipt, laughing and cheering toward the camera as they summarize their shopping trip.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal female voice begins an energetic narration over an upbeat, synthetic electronic pop track. The speaker's pitch is high and delivery is rapid, establishing a vlog-like persona. BGM tempo is approximately 124 BPM with a strong backbeat. (2) A sharp mechanical metallic clink occurs as a shopping cart is moved, followed by a vocalized gasp ('Wow!') of surprise. The BGM continues steadily in the background. (3) Continuous fast-paced speech details various items. The acoustic environment shifts slightly to an indoor room tone with subtle reverberation from the supermarket space. (4) A short 'ding' sound effect emphasizes a price reveal. The voice remains bright and enthusiastic, with frequent upward pitch contours. (5) Sound of a refrigerator handle clicking and glass door opening. The narrator's voice remains dominant, maintaining high speech density. (6) Laughter from multiple female voices overlaps as they react to the blueberries, followed by a final swelling of the electronic music during the group's outdoor summary.
